description: The full score: tempo and meter with their changes, markers, parts, each part's devices with every param, sends, regions and their notes, and automation, each position in beats, seconds and frames. include narrows what comes back; left out, everything. The server keeps a score 7 days after last use: for work longer than that, save this document on your side (it is the music) and restore it with score.load.
